rubrics.justification: Describes a plausible expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, compact A-grade ICM, and looser B-grade TE, but includes uncertainty and some grading-stage ambiguity (3AB vs 4AB) rather than a precise image-grounded analysis.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrium, BMI, lifestyle, and semen parameters well, and appropriately notes hydrosalpinx as a key modifier, though some links to embryo-specific prognosis are somewhat generic.

Overall logic is reasonable, but the response contains repeated and shifting probability ranges, some internal inconsistency about implantation vs clinical pregnancy/live birth, and a few speculative points.

Mostly consistent with IVF practice on morphology, age-related prognosis, single good-quality blastocyst transfer context, and hydrosalpinx caution, but includes questionable details such as hCG testing five days post-transfer and some loose Gardner terminology.

Provides some practical recommendations (confirm no hydrosalpinx, luteal support, avoid bed rest, consider uterine evaluation if failures recur), but advice is only moderately specific and future planning is not deeply developed.
